title: Risk-Score Addition for Prior Authorization Extension Requests
content:
The units a Prairie Ridge Prior Authorization extension request asks for carry a risk addition that follows the risk score on the member's active Care Management episode.

## Risk bands

| Risk score on the active Care Management episode | Units added |
|---|---|
| 3.00 or more | 2 |
| 2.00 up to 2.99 | 1 |
| below 2.00 | 0 |
| no active Care Management episode | 0 |

The addition is made once to the units the extension request asks for, before the floor of zero is applied. Only the episode whose status is active is read; a closed or ended episode's score does not count.

## Boundary scores (hypothetical)

- A score of 3.00 adds 2 units; a score of 2.99 adds 1 unit.
- A score of 2.00 adds 1 unit; a score of 1.99 adds nothing.
- A member with no active Care Management episode has no score read, and nothing is added.
